name: Rakuyou no Toki
original_name: 落陽の刻　～らくようのとき～
source:
Tatsuya is Ryuuya descendant. During the era of wars he challenges female warrior to make a name for himself, but she turns to be reincarnation of Kanna whom his clan vowed to protect. The two pass through these tragic times together.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
Tatsuya是柳也的后裔。战乱年代，他为扬名而向一位女武者挑战，却发现她竟是自己一族誓言守护的神奈的转世。两人一同走过这段悲剧性的岁月。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
